node.label: 1. 确定增益 K 以满足带宽要求：选取 K 使开环截止频率比期望的闭环带宽低一半。2. 利用步骤 1 得到的 K 值评估未校正系统的相角裕度（PM）。3. 留出额外裕量（约 10°），并确定所需的超前相角 φmax。4. 根据式 (6.40) 或图 6.53 确定 α。5. 选取 ωmax 为截止频率；从而零点位于 1/TD = ωmax √α，极点位于 1/αTD = ωmax / √α。6. 绘制校正后的频率响应曲线并校验相角裕度。7. 对设计进行迭代。
node.description: 1. Determine the gain K to satisfy bandwidth requirements: pick K so that the open-loop crossover frequency is a factor of two below the desired closed-loop bandwidth. 2. Evaluate the PM of the uncompensated system using the value of K obtained from Step 1. 3. Allow for extra margin (about 10°), and determine the needed phase lead φmax. 4. Determine α from Eq. (6.40) or Fig. 6.53. 5. Pick ωmax to be at the crossover frequency; thus the zero is at 1/TD = ωmax √α and the pole is at 1/αTD = ωmax / √α. 6. Draw the compensated frequency response and check the PM. 7. Iterate on the design.
